about.title: Our Story
about.intro: Pink Boots Society was founded in 2007 by Teri Fahrendorf, a master brewer who traveled across the United States brewing beer alongside other women in the industry. What began as a road trip became a global movement.
about.mission: Pink Boots Society aims to assist, inspire and encourage women and non-binary individuals in the fermented and alcoholic beverage industry to advance their careers through education.
about.vision: To be Latin America's leading network that makes women and non-binary individuals in the fermented and alcoholic beverage industry more visible, connected, and empowered — until we achieve a diverse and equitable industry.
about.latamIntro: Pink Boots Society Latin America is the parent chapter for the entire region. From Mexico to Patagonia, including Brazil, we unite women and non-binary individuals passionate about beer and fermented beverages. We believe our different cultures share one passion: beer.
